answer.says: Ramesh, I am in your debt, and the shame of it is mine, not yours. I will find the money for the rice and the wages by the end of this week. For now, the chai is enough. I have sat with this file and this hunger long enough; the air outside is thick, but a walk may clear the head better than the study.
answer.thought: The system of needs has failed me at its most basic level; I am reduced to tea because I cannot feed the man who feeds me. There is a tension here between my pride and my poverty that I must resolve through action, not reflection. I need to move, to leave this stagnant air and this stagnant house.
